summary: Recursion Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting an underwriting agreement dated October 15, 2026 with Leerink, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley and Evercore as representatives for a $200 million follow-on offering of 61,540,000 Class A shares at $3.25 per share, all sold by the company under an effective Form S-3ASR shelf. Expected close October 16, 2026. Executive officers, directors and certain related entities agreed to 45-day lock-ups. Gross proceeds before discounts and expenses; no premium, board recommendation or target/merger terms apply. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing pressure and post-deal overhang.
